note: The window of a term (spec/translation-file/term-edit.md): its word and its written forms, every act answering a NEW draft. ONE act writes: `write` (Apply (N), N = `count`); the impact is said before (`effect`, from term_changes); a form a sentence cites cannot be removed (`blockers`). A draft is `{key, word, word_touched, forms:[{id, text, added}], selected, is_new, becomes, original:{v, forms:[{id, text}]}}`; a line is the file's: `{v, t, term?, forms?, use?, class?, oracle?, links?, unlinked?}`. Lines of `file` are in the file's order; `lookup` is `{key: line}`; `lists` is `{name: [values]}`.

problem.out: empty-key | bad-key | key-is-term | cites | empty-word | empty-form | null

after.out: line: the term's line as it would be

effect.out: {texts, review, uses: [{key, kind, text_changes, needs_review_after}], forms_to_redo}

write.out: {key, value, value_changed, tag, original_value, original_tag, is_new, fields} | null
